inputs.original_text:
Wake up and look at the real coordination happening right behind the scenes. Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is just parading out the latest compliance script for the hidden puppet masters, packaged up to look like a benevolent manifesto. They are pushing a calculated mechanism for total dependency and control, funded through massive foreign debt and hidden FDI growth agendas.

They want us to swallow the official story about generosity—doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, handing out Rs 8,000 household coupons, and buying off the agricultural sector with free motor pumpsets. But do not fall for any of it. The promises of job creation, enhanced support for fishermen, and a heavy push into AI development are nothing more than code for expanding their digital surveillance apparatus to monitor every single move we make. Every single "benefit" they list is just a shackle designed to tighten the elite's grip over the population.
